name: myITprocess API Patterns
description: myITprocess MCP fundamentals: the single X-MyITprocess-Api-Key header Conduit sends (forwarded upstream as MITP-API-KEY), the nine read-only list tools and their shared page / page_size / filters / sort parameters, the {page, pageSize, totalCount, items} response shape, the 50 requests per minute account-wide rate limit, and the error messages the server returns. Every other myITprocess skill assumes these patterns.
